reviews.author: Joydeep Mukherjee
reviews.text:

reviews.author: Mella Manuel
reviews.text: Their service is really nice. I showed them a photo of the style I wanted for my dog, and even though my dog had a lot of hairballs/matted fur, they didn’t refuse or suggest shaving everything bald. Big kudos to the groomer for patiently removing the mats and still following the style we wanted. Very happy with the result and the care they gave my dog. 🐶✨

reviews.author: Dada_psv
reviews.text:
Forever grateful to Forever Pet Care and especially Dr. Nasseren, the owner, and the entire team for the care, compassion, and kindness shown to my puppies during one of the hardest moments for me emotionally.

When both my babies were diagnosed with Parvo, I was completely broken down in tears and fear. But Dr. Nasseren and the team didn’t just treat my puppies — they comforted me too. They stayed close, spoke with kindness, patience, and genuine care, giving me hope when I was emotionally falling apart. Even when they saw me completely broken down, they never stopped caring for my babies like they were their own.

The treatment, attention, and dedication given to Hope and Toby truly meant everything to me. What touched my heart even more was how considerate and affordable the care was during such a difficult time.

Thank you for treating not only the pets, but also the pet parents with compassion and humanity. I will always remember the support, reassurance, and love shown to us during these painful days.

Highly grateful and highly recommended. ❤️

reviews.author: Swaleha Nagdade
reviews.text:
Very Disappointing Experience

We were referred to this vet from the pet shop after buying a kitten as a gift for our toddler. The staff initially seems helpful, but they mislead and fool you with their talk.
We highlighted a visible scratch near the kitten’s nose and ear earlier to the seller and also to the vet and they both said it’s a simple scratch after checking and testing it.

They also pushed unnecessary tests (250 AED) for some virus check and additional products/services, making us spend over 500+ AED overall just at the vet clinic. There is a lady (possibly the owner herself), who is very manipulative and creates pressure to buy unnecessary stuff under the name of safety and comfort for pets and kids.

Within a week, the kitten’s condition worsened. A second vet (in Dubai) confirmed it was ringworm, not a scratch—a contagious infection unsafe for children. We had to give up the kitten, which was heartbreaking for our child, and spend another 500+ AED on home disinfection.

We feel misled and taken advantage of.
Please be careful. This place seems more focused on selling than proper care and they have tied up policies with the pet shops.

reviews.author: Mohammed Shareef
reviews.text:
I recently took my furry friend to forever  Salon, and I can’t say enough good things about it! From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was warm and welcoming. The staff greeted us with big smiles and lots of affection for my cat, which immediately put me at ease.

The grooming area was clean, organized, and smelled delightful—not at all like a typical pet salon. I appreciated that they had a variety of grooming packages tailored to different breeds and needs. They took the time to explain everything, ensuring I was comfortable with what they would be doing.

The groomer truly showed a passion for pets! They listened attentively to my requests and handled my dog with such care and love. It was evident my pup was in good hands. After the grooming, my cat looked absolutely stunning—fluffy, shiny, and oh-so-happy!

Moreover, they offer additional services like nail trimming, baths, and even pet massages, which is a fantastic bonus. The prices were reasonable for the quality of service provided.

Overall, I highly recommend forever pet Salon to any pet owner looking for a great grooming experience. My pet came out happy and pampered, and I couldn’t be more thrilled with the results! I’ll definitely be returning for regular visits. 🐾💕

reviews.author: hanna mathew
reviews.text:
Forever Pet Care has been the best veterinary clinic in Sharjah. The owner, doctors, and staff are all incredibly kind and supportive. They’ve been there for us since the very first day we got our puppy, which really means a lot.

They also have a pet accessory store right next to the clinic, so it’s super convenient to get everything you need in one place. Plus, they offer boarding services as well, which is a big help.

As a pet parent, I’m truly happy and satisfied with their services, and I’ll definitely keep going back.

reviews.text:
Highly recommend this place and I would recommend especially asking for the guy who did the shower for my cat, unfortunately don’t have his name but hopefully the picture helps.

Little back story, we adopted her at 4 years old from the shelter and she had a fear of any hair dryer, she cannot be in the same room. However we had to get her a medicated bath to treat her ringworm.

I’m glad we were recommended forever pet care and especially got assigned the groomer who did the shower for our cat. He was very gentle with her, took it slow and didn’t rush the process knowing she has a fear of hairdryers. We usually give her showers at home but if we ever needed to take her to the groomers this is where we’ll be going.
